scope.goal: Deliver Issue #206 S1 support policy, matrix, and read-only route resolver.
scope.target: Exact retained-origin routes for immediate predecessor, v0.9.0, and v0.6.0 without target mutation.
constraints: Use exactly direct, orchestrated-multi-hop, reconciliation-required, and unsupported route kinds.
Bind exact route edges, assets, validators, checksums, and semantic cutovers.
Fail before mutation on ambiguity, missing assets, unsupported schemas, validator disagreement, or cutover bypass.
Require explicit owner, matrix, and release-note evidence for support deprecation.
non_goals: Implement S2 transaction composition or S3 release proof
Create a tag or Release or publish assets/packages

architecture_decisions: S1 returns a sealed read-only plan and never calls package apply.
A proven direct route is preferred only when it preserves required semantic cutovers.
A retained origin cannot become unsupported without complete explicit deprecation evidence.
user_constraints: One Issue #206 and one workflow across three sequential PRs.
S1 uses Refs #206 and records that transaction and release proof remain.
